Ava (CEO): Heads-up — quick all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. Plan is ~40m + 20m open Q&A. Please drop any questions here by EOD. Agenda: 1) Q3 launches + Dedicated rollout status 2) Security policy update (data residency) 3) Customer reliability recap 4) Hiring snapshot + org updates.
Marta (VP Product): Adding a short demo of the new routing controls. Will need 5 mins for live demo.
Jon (Eng Lead): Can we get the deploy dashboard link in the deck? Helps call out latency trends.
Ava (CEO): Yes — Marta, add the deploy dashboard slide. Also quick note: we'll call out the Dedicated availability window for EU customers.
Priya (Security): For the policy update, I'll summarize the new KMS integration timelines and what it means for Private customers. Will post a one-pager in #docs after the meeting.
Elena (People Ops): Reminder: hybrid viewing location and captioning will be available. Link for RSVP: https://calendar.company/allhands-q3
Sam (Ops): Can we include the incident postmortem highlights (May 12) — 2 slides max with mitigation & followups.
Ava (CEO): Good call, Sam. Keep it crisp. Also planning to announce the pilot for customer-managed audit logs.
Ravi (SRE): Heads-up — we'll include a short SLO update and a note about automatic fallback improvements.
Marta (VP Product): Thanks everyone. If you have a question for the exec panel (finance/sales/legal), mark with "@panel" and I'll collect.
Jon (Eng Lead): @panel — will there be guidance for teams on rollout windows for model updates to avoid noisy regressions?
Ava (CEO): @Jon we'll cover rollout guardrails and can share templates for canary configs.
Marta (VP Product): Recording will be uploaded to the company drive post-meeting. I'll drop the link here.
DevOpsBot: Recording uploaded: https://drive.company/recordings/allhands_q3_3100001111.mp4 :speaker:
Elena (People Ops): TL;DR for folks who can't attend — we'll share key takeaways + action items by EOD Friday.
Priya (Security): Q for the panel — what are the immediate requirements for EU data residency pilot? Short answer: expected timeline and account opt-in.
Ava (CEO): We'll announce timeline and opt-in procedure during the policy segment.
Marta (VP Product): Post-meeting action items I already have: 1) Share deploy dashboard slide 2) Upload demo assets 3) Draft rollout guardrail template 4) Post the KMS one-pager — tagging responsible owners.
Sam (Ops): Will the Dedicated capacity docs be updated with burst policy examples?
Marta (VP Product): Yes — ops will add burst examples. @Sam can you draft 2 examples by Tuesday?
Sam (Ops): On it.
Ava (CEO): Thanks team. Please keep questions here so we can collate. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
